Parley can ask for your phone\'s fingerprint or screen lock, or for a PIN of its own. Incoming calls and emergency calls never wait for either.

What a duress PIN hides, and what it can\'t do
Your Parley PIN stays. Nothing that was hidden is lost.
Different from your Parley PIN. Pick one you\'ll remember under stress.

The duress PIN opens Parley as usual, but hides private contacts and their calls, Circle notes and promises, notes for calls and call notes, family safe words and Shared with. Private contacts who call ring as unknown numbers. Nothing is deleted.
They stay hidden, also after Parley locks or the phone restarts, until you unlock with your Parley PIN. Settings show the duress PIN as if it didn\'t exist.

While a duress PIN is set, only a PIN opens Parley, not your fingerprint or screen lock. Parley can\'t recover a forgotten PIN: you would have to clear Parley\'s storage in Android\'s settings, and private contacts not in a backup would be lost.

It can\'t help against someone who knows about duress PINs, or who copies the phone\'s storage with special tools. It hides nothing outside Parley: other apps, Android\'s own settings and the system call history stay as they are.
